scope_caveat: Local optimum over the explicitly tested candidate pool only; not a mathematical or global proof of optimality.

authority.note: PASS covers only the 8 complete configurations in the pool (raw baseline, registry canonical export, preferred six, five-swap keeping Etherium Sculptor, four-swap keeping the myriad package, Pass C's Kindred-over-Research Thief six-swap, Pass C's Karlach-over-Biotransference six-swap and the Combat Celebrant seven-swap) plus named single-card contenders. They were judged with finite current-Oracle rules cases, bounded enumerations answering the Pass C requested measured tests (Kindred Discovery vs Research Thief / Thopter Spy Network / Canoptek Spyder draws over 5 fixed boards x 5 hit rates; Karlach and Hexplate trigger and tempo counts), Commander Spellbook combo lookups and a quantity-counted mana comparison. Tests run locally and in .github/workflows/m7-cult-of-skaro.yml; run URLs are recorded in the PR body. There is no statistical multiplayer ranking, no shared opponent/mana sample and no removal-response rate. The A/B seals and the owner-equivalent Pass C (final disposition NEEDS TESTING) are historical, baseline-scoped and not technically independent. Nothing here implies owner approval, M6 certification, M7 approval or a canonical change.
